classification: New exploratory generalization series, outcome-independent preregistration; does not replace or pool with frozen remediation v1
checkpoint_assignment: 8 independently sampled geometries per one of three historical fixed checkpoints; checkpoint not crossed within a geometry
design: 24 independently drawn relay geometries; both onset settings and both channel settings crossed within each geometry, along with both malicious relay placements, two timing settings, and five arms
limitations: One radio seed per geometry×onset×channel and one permutation; geometry range extends beyond original ±1m but is not a universal connectivity or node-count scalability benchmark

analysis_plan.unit: geometry cluster n=24; average paired conditions within geometry
analysis_plan.primary: post-onset unique sink delivery; negative-update main effect at native and scheduled processing
analysis_plan.testing: cluster-level paired bootstrap and exact or Monte Carlo sign-flip, separate prespecified family from remediation v1
analysis_plan.interaction: estimate onset and channel interactions within geometry, report intervals and multiplicity; do not select cases on outcome
analysis_plan.missing: retain failed/disconnected cases as outcomes; differentiate infrastructure failure from legitimate disconnected geometry
